claim_boundary: This preflight is readiness evidence only. It cannot close USB, LAN, or input latency gates; only a passing formal latency evidence report with retained real measurement artifacts can do that.

notes: No external-camera or optical single-timebase package is retained for USB or LAN glass-to-glass latency.
No raw high-frame-rate camera recording or annotated latency samples are retained for the README latency profiles.
No synchronized-clock input package with a reviewable sub-5 ms total error budget is retained for input latency.
Unsynchronized host/client telemetry, decoder timings, RTT, screenshots, and ADB-generated input remain diagnostics only and cannot close these gates.
